The promise, then six different reasons to use Safer. Same brand, same type, same characters; different scene on every tile. Reels will teach the features, so these stay about real situations.

Before the first post

  1. Create the account with support@safer.global and claim @safer.global.
  2. Bio link: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761288625 (the App Store page) or https://web.safer.global.
  3. No numbers, no traction claims, no pilot or early-access wording.

Posted 1 → 7 in the order below, the profile grid shows them newest first: uneasy · people · walking / choose · SOS · family / never walk alone. The intro sits in the bottom row on its own until post 8 arrives. The red SOS tile is in the middle row.
